decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The permission hereby granted for all the portable buildings part of this application shall be for a limited period expiring on 22 May 2006, when the portable buildings adjacent to the Medical Block (Drawing nos: 00-0004/946-05, 946-11 Rev C, MBBC-0001-01, 946/6), north of 'O'Block (Drawing nos:  00-0004/946-05, 954-01, WP001002 Rev A, 954/S1A, 954/L1A, 954/L2A & unnumbered plan received 10.05.2001) and portable toilet buildings and corridor near building 4 (on Drawing nos 00-0004/946-05, Photos and cabin plan received 12.03.2001, 00/0004 - 04 & - 01)
description: Erection of single storey flank extension and new compressor unit to Percy House (Dental Dept), corridor to existing toilet block, retention of toilets, and erection of a portable building at basement level to medical block of hospital and relocation of existing portable buildings on site.
